import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender (heatmap style bar plot)
survival_by_class_gender = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
x = np.arange(len(survival_by_class_gender.index))
width = 0.35

bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(x - width/2, survival_by_class_gender['male'], width, 
                       label='Male', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = axes[0, 0].bar(x + width/2, survival_by_class_gender['female'], width, 
                       label='Female', color='lightcoral', alpha=0.8)

axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 0].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, 1)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
                       f'{height:.1%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status (violin plot)
axes[0, 1].remove()
ax_violin = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)
violin_parts = ax_violin.violinplot([df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna(),
                                     df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()],
                                    showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
ax_violin.set_xticks([1, 2])
ax_violin.set_xticklabels(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])
ax_violin.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax_violin.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', 
                    fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# Customize violin plot colors
for i, pc in enumerate(violin_parts['bodies']):
    if i == 0:
        pc.set_facecolor('lightcoral')
        pc.set_edgecolor('darkred')
        pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    else:
        pc.set_facecolor('lightgreen')
        pc.set_edgecolor('darkgreen')
        pc.set_alpha(0.7)

# Customize median and mean lines
violin_parts['cmedians'].set_color('black')
violin_parts['cmedians'].set_linewidth(2)
violin_parts['cmeans'].set_color('yellow')
violin_parts['cmeans'].set_linewidth(2)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).sort_values('mean', ascending=False)
colors = ['lightgreen', 'lightblue', 'lightcoral']
bars3 = axes[1, 0].bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival['mean'], 
                       color=colors, alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)

axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', 
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 0].set_ylim(0, 0.7)
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add value labels and passenger counts
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars3, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.01,
                   f'{height:.1%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., -0.05,
                   f'n={count}', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by survival and passenger class (box plot)
axes[1, 1].remove()
ax_box = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4)
box_data = []
labels = []
colors_box = []

for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    for survived in [0, 1]:
        fare_data = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == survived)]['fare'].dropna()
        if len(fare_data) > 0:
            box_data.append(fare_data)
            status = 'Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Not Survived'
            labels.append(f'Class {pclass}\n{status}')
            colors_box.append('lightgreen' if survived == 1 else 'lightcoral')

box_plot = ax_box.boxplot(box_data, patch_artist=True, labels=labels, 
                         showfliers=False, medianprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=2))

# Color the boxes
for patch, color in zip(box_plot['boxes'], colors_box):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax_box.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax_box.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class and Survival', 
                fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax_box.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax_box.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
